mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia) that increase metoclopramide's risk of QT prolongation and cardiac arrhythmias; both drugs can affect GI motility and fluid/electrolyte balance.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, potassium) closely during concurrent use; consider alternative antiemetic if possible; perform baseline and periodic ECG monitoring.
